test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined part in the following sentence.

My entire family __left me in the lurch__ when I went to them after I divorced my husband.

options.text: blamed only me for my failure
refused to help me in my distress

solution: The correct answer is **Option 3)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"left me in the lurch"** means to abandon someone when they are in trouble or in a difficult situation. (मुसीबत में छोड़ देना) • **Example:** He **left me in the lurch **when I needed him the most. • **"Refused to help me in my distress"** means not providing assistance when someone is in a state of suffering or difficulty. (मेरी परेशानी में मदद करने से इनकार कर दिया) • **Example:** My friends **refused to help me in my distress**, leaving me to cope on my own. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. refused to help me in my distress. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Attempted to harass me** (मुझे परेशान करने की कोशिश की): Tried to annoy or trouble me. • **Example:** He **attempted to harass me** by constantly calling and messaging. • **Blamed only me for my failure** (मेरी असफलता के लिए केवल मुझे दोषी ठहराया): Held me solely responsible for my failure. • **Example:** They **blamed only me for my failure** in the project. • **Scorned me for committing mistakes** (गलतियाँ करने के लिए मेरी अवहेलना की): Showed contempt or disdain towards me for making errors. • **Example:** My teacher **scorned me for committing mistakes** in the exam. 59:Tbcf, The correct answer is **Option 4)**
